comments.author: Juicebox
comments.body: Word on the street is the New Canned Tuna Olive steak is selling for 3-4 mil a can. This will restore cooking to prominence.

comments.author: Caddy
comments.body:
If you do the math, Tuna Olive steak conservatively sells at 15-20k (sometimes more). It takes 110 to make a can, so that's about 2.2m to make a can. Next, factor in the 30? Tin Plate it takes to make a can. Then, you gotta factor in the labor of carting full loads of TOS for 3 cans at a time.

I heard people offering 15m a can the other night in merchant chat. This could be a fluke, and I'm not sure if the price has yet stabilized, but I would guess that it's higher than 3-4m a can, strictly from the labor alone.

comments.author: Adog
comments.body: I definitely have to agree with Caddy here, I have seen Tinned/Canned Tuna Olive Steak go for around 5-8m on merchant chat. More than 3-4m a can, and I think, as juicebox said, it will likely make cooking a more lucrative niche, though it would still not match other crafting niches such as handicrafts and casting as their applications are much more widespread and highly demanded.
